Exact-ID hits rank first in request order, then records matched directly by the

relevance_score.description: Reciprocal-rank-fusion score over the exact-ID, lexical, semantic and graph hits. Measures relevance to the query only — not severity, exploitability or confidence. Structured hits record why the candidate satisfied the filters and add no score.

ModelReply.description:
What a model port returns: raw plan text, so the core always does the parsing, or
the reason it has none, as one of the server's sentences.

A round records the reply it got in full, within the plan text's length cap, so the
audit can parse and gate it again. Plan text is untrusted model output: data, never
written to a log or a warning and never read as an instruction.

detail.description: The server's sentence for why the planner gave no plan.

plan_text.description: Untrusted model output: the plan as the model wrote it.
plan_text.title: Plan Text

ModelReply.title: ModelReply

ModelReplyFailureDetail.description:
Why a model planner gave no plan, one fixed server sentence per reason: an adapter
picks the reason and never writes the text, so no adapter or endpoint text reaches a
trajectory.
enum: the model endpoint could not be reached
the model endpoint did not answer within the time left
the model endpoint rejected the configured credentials
the model endpoint refused the request under its rate limit
the model endpoint answered with an error
the model endpoint's answer held no plan text
the model planner adapter raised an error or gave no valid reply
ModelReplyFailureDetail.title: ModelReplyFailureDetail

PlannerOutcome.description:
How a round's plan was chosen.

``deterministic``: no model planner is configured, so the policy planned the round.
``model_accepted``: the model's plan passed the gate and runs. ``model_rejected`` and
``model_unavailable``: the model's reply failed the gate or carried no plan, so the
round falls back to the policy's plan. ``model_reply_after_deadline`` and
``model_timed_out``: the model replied at or after the deadline, or not at all, so
nothing runs. ``model_skipped_at_deadline``: a model is configured, but the deadline
had passed before the round was planned, so it was never consulted. Every outcome but
``deterministic``, ``model_timed_out`` and ``model_skipped_at_deadline`` has a reply,
which the round records.
PlannerOutcome.title: PlannerOutcome

lexical or semantic match, or a graph relation to one, to become a candidate.
Values are kept exactly as sent. CWE IDs and severities are accepted only in
canonical upper case; vendors, products and purls match case-insensitively.
